orvath_intro.speaker: orvath
orvath_intro.text: Quiet! Step lightly on the catwalk! One false step and the vibration will shatter the ninth-hour chime. I am Master Bell-Smith Orvath, and right now I am staring at the end of my career.

start_quest.title: The Cracked Resonator
start_quest.desc: Assist Master Bell-Smith Orvath in tuning the fractured Meridian Bell of House Serenthil to prevent a catastrophic sonic overload.
stages: Inspect the hairline resonant fracture on the Great Meridian Bell
Dampen the anomalous planar feedback and tune the alloy

choices.text: What happened to the chime, Master Orvath?
[Arcana Check] That's not metal fatigue. That micro-fracture is glowing with inverted planar feedback from the Northreach tear.

orvath_explain.speaker: orvath
orvath_explain.text: The Meridian Bell regulates every time-sigil in Starfall. Ever since the distant tremor last week, every time the clapper strikes the silver-bronze skirt, the note doesn't decay—it rings louder and louder, building a harmonic feedback loop. Look at that hairline crack along the lip!

choices.text: If it strikes the ninth bell during the festival, the entire bell tower will collapse.

orvath_arcana_pass.speaker: orvath
orvath_arcana_pass.text: By the Song... you're Elorin Voidweaver! Yes! The bell is drinking ambient planar dissonance through the conduit network. It's vibrating at thirty-four thousand cycles, and my smiths can't get close enough with a chisel without getting their teeth rattled out!

choices.text: I can dampen the void feedback if you can weld the silver seam.

orvath_arcana_fail.speaker: orvath
orvath_arcana_fail.text: Whatever is causing it, the metal is ringing itself to death! If the Conclave hears that House Serenthil can't keep the hour, they'll seize our foundries.

choices.text: Let us examine the tuning procedure.

orvath_tuning_plan.speaker: orvath
orvath_tuning_plan.text: We need to execute a three-part harmonic stabilization. Someone must manually dampen the standing acoustic wave, apply a cold void-focus to draw out the excess planar charge, and strike the tuning node with exact counter-resonance. How do you propose we proceed?

advance_quest.desc: Execute harmonic tuning on the Great Meridian Bell.

choices.text: [Voidweaver] Let me weave a null-envelope directly around the fracture to swallow the acoustic feedback.
[Harmonist] I will sing the counter-harmonic fourth octave to neutralize the resonance wave before it peaks.
[Vigor Check] (Grip the acoustic tuning bar with raw physical strength and force the damping plate against the vibrating lip.)
[Acumen Check] Recalculate the thermal expansion ratio of the silver alloy and quench the crack with liquid quartz.

orvath_voidweaver_pass.speaker: orvath
orvath_voidweaver_pass.text: Look at the dark mist wrapping the crack! The ringing stopped instantly! The metal is cool to the touch! Hand me the silver flux—I'm sealing the seam right now!

orvath_harmonist_pass.speaker: orvath
orvath_harmonist_pass.text: The pitch... it smoothed out like calm water! The dissonance resolved into a perfect pure meridian fifth! The weld is taking hold beautifully!

orvath_vigor_pass.speaker: orvath
orvath_vigor_pass.text: Hold it! Hold it steady against the roar! *CLANG-SSSSHHH.* The damping held! The silver flux has bonded into the fracture! Release the bar!

choices.text: Let us hear the true tone.

orvath_vigor_fail.speaker: orvath
orvath_vigor_fail.text: The vibration tore the bar out of your hands! *DONGGG-SCREEECH!* The shockwave threw us both into the safety netting! But... the flux partially caught! We barely saved the bell!

orvath_acumen_pass.speaker: orvath
orvath_acumen_pass.text: The liquid quartz crystalized into the alloy matrix at the exact eutectic temperature! The crack is sealed from within, stronger than the original cast!

orvath_acumen_fail.speaker: orvath
orvath_acumen_fail.text: The quartz cooled too quickly! A lump of slag formed on the edge! Let me take a file to it... *scrape scrape*... It will hold, but the chime has a rough undertone now.

choices.text: At least the tower will not collapse.

orvath_success.speaker: orvath
orvath_success.text: *BLLLLOOOOMMM.* Listen to that deep, pure, golden sustain. Not a single rattle. The hour of Starfall is secure. Here, take this Tuned Meridian Ingot and my personal seal of gratitude, Voidweaver. House Serenthil will not forget this.

orvath_success_strained.speaker: orvath
orvath_success_strained.text: It tolls, though with a somber hollow rasp. The Conclave won't notice the difference, but my pride is bruised. Still, you saved my neck from the inquisitors. Take this stipend and my thanks.
